summary.text: Laura Cisneros is the Republican candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 38, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Democratic incumbent Erin Gamez.
Her Ballotpedia profile lists her as an oncologist who was born and raised in Brownsville.

paragraphs.text: Laura Cisneros was born and raised in Brownsville, Texas, and her career experience is listed as working as an oncologist.
In 2024 she ran in the Republican primary for U.S. House Texas District 34, finishing second with 8.8 percent of the vote behind Mayra Flores, who received 81.2 percent.
She advanced from the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for the Texas House with no primary opponent.
